lang.name: Hausa
theme.aria: Sauya tsakanin yanayin haske da duhu
hero.kicker: Aikin Foehn · hasashen bincike kai tsaye
hero.tag: Ina ƙananan ƙura za su kasance gobe da kwanakin da ke biye?
hero.lede: Kowace safiya Otso yana ɗaukar nazarin ƙarfe 00 UTC na Hukumar Sa ido kan Sararin Samaniya ta Copernicus, hasashen yanayi na ECMWF na lokaci ɗaya da gobarar da tauraron ɗan adam ya gani, yana ƙididdige jigilar iska da FLEXGREEN, sannan yana hasashen PM2.5 a kan dukan ƙasa, daga awa 12 zuwa kwana 5 a gaba, a matsayin rukuni na mambobi 8. Otso shi ne samfurin mai faɗi (0.4°) na takardar Foehn, wanda aka ƙara horar da shi da bayanan kai tsaye na 2026. Foehn mai kilomita 1 ba ya aiki a lokaci na gaske.
disc.title: Hasashen bincike.
disc.long: Otso gwaji ne na wata ƙungiyar jami'a, ba sabis na hukuma ba. Har yanzu ba a tantance shi a lokaci na gaske ba, ba a sa ido a kansa dare da rana ba, kuma ba ya maye gurbin hasashe, ma'auni da faɗakarwar ingancin iska na hukumomin ƙasarku ko na yankinku. Idan dole ne ka yanke wani shawara game da lafiyarka, yi amfani da su.
disc.short: Ba faɗakarwar hukuma ba ce: don shawarwarin lafiya, yi amfani da sabis na ingancin iska na ƙasarka.
install.sub_desktop: Duba lambar da wayarka don buɗe Otso a can, sannan ka ƙara shi a allon gida:
install.sub_rest: babu abin da za a sauke daga kanti, yana buɗewa a cikakken allo kamar manhaja, yana adana hasashen ƙarshe idan babu intanet, kuma yana sabunta kansa kowace safiya.
install.ios_1: Duba lambar, ko buɗe ammarkheder.com/Foehn/otso a Safari (ba a mai binciken wata manhaja ba).
install.ios_2: Taɓa Raba ⎙ (murabba'i mai kibiya, a ƙasa).
install.ios_3: Gungura ka zaɓi Ƙara zuwa Allon Gida, sannan Ƙara.
install.ios_4: Otso yana kan allon gidanka kuma yana buɗewa a cikakken allo; yana adana hasashen ƙarshe idan babu intanet.
install.android_1: Duba lambar, ko buɗe ammarkheder.com/Foehn/otso a Chrome.
install.android_2: Taɓa maɓallin Saka Otso da ke ƙarƙashin lambar idan ya bayyana, ko menu na ⋮ → Ƙara zuwa allon gida / Saka manhaja.
install.android_3: Tabbatar. Otso zai bayyana tare da sauran manhajoji.
install.desktop_2: Danna alamar sakawa a dama da sandar adireshi, ko menu → Saka Otso (Firefox da Safari a Mac: adana shi a matsayin alamar shafi).
install.desktop_3: Otso yana buɗewa a tagarsa ta kansa.
install.note: Ana tuna garinka a wannan na'urar kawai (ba a aika komai ko'ina). Sabon hasashe yana fitowa kowace rana kusan ƙarfe 12:30 UTC. Hasashen bincike ne, ba faɗakarwa ba: manhajar ba ta aika sanarwa.
install.done: An saka Otso a wannan na'urar. Sabon hasashe yana fitowa kowace rana kusan ƙarfe 12:30 UTC.
map.sub: Kai alamar linzami ko taɓa wuri don ganin ƙimarsa; danna don adana shi ka ga yadda yake canzawa cikin kwana biyar. Gungura ko matse da yatsu don zuƙowa, ja don motsa taswira. Matakai: matsakaicin mambobi 8, kashi na 90 nasu (mummunan yanayi mai yiwuwa), da rabon mambobin da suka wuce 25 µg m<sup>−3</sup>, iyakar matakin «matsakaici» na Ma'aunin Ingancin Iska na Turai don PM<sub>2.5</sub>.
city.label: Garinka
city.geo_title: Yi amfani da wurin wannan na'urar
city.note: Kowane gari ko ƙauye: wurare 34,000 masu mazauna sama da 15,000 suna bayyana nan take (GeoNames, CC BY 4.0), sauran suna zuwa daga OpenStreetMap yayin da kake rubutu (© masu ba da gudummawa ga OpenStreetMap). Kana iya danna taswira ko amfani da wurinka. Hasashen na akwatin 0.4° ne (kusan kilomita 40) da ke ɗauke da wurin.
city.ph_app: Garinka: rubuta shi, ko yi amfani da wurinka
welcome.title: Ina kake?
welcome.text: Otso yana nuna hasashen wurin da kake kuma yana tuna shi don lokaci na gaba. Wurinka yana zama a wannan na'urar.

adv.good: Iska mai kyau. Ji daɗin ayyukanka na waje kamar yadda ka saba.
adv.fair: Iska mai gamsarwa. Ayyukan yau da kullum ba su da matsala; mutane masu tsananin hankali na iya ji.
adv.moderate: Gurɓataccen iska matsakaici. Mutane masu rauni su yi la'akari da rage dogon aiki ko mai wahala a waje.
adv.poor: Iska mara kyau. Mutane masu rauni su taƙaita aiki a waje; sauran kowa su yi la'akari da rage shi.
adv.very_poor: Iska mara kyau sosai. Kowa ya taƙaita aiki a waje.

cities.sub: Ana wallafa manyan birane sittin tare da kowane hasashe; rubuta kowane gari ko ƙauye a cikin akwatin don ƙara shi a tebur (ana ƙididdige shi a nan daga matakan hasashe kuma ana adana shi a wannan na'urar). Ƙimomin matsakaicin rukuni ne a kan akwatuna 3 × 3 da ke kewaye da wurin; sandunan suna nuna lokuta goma daga +awa 12 zuwa +awa 120. Danna jere don sanya taswira a tsakiyarsa; tsara ta kowane ginshiƙi.
